capabilities: Tamper-evident flight recorder for agent actions: an append-only, hash-chained record store signed at ingest by a recorder-held key the recorded agent never touches

Credential shape is the security model: agents hold per-agent submission credentials (append-only, own name only); the owner credential reads, verifies and exports but cannot append — the recorded agent cannot read, grade, or rewrite its own record; auth is not an oracle (unknown id and wrong secret refuse byte-identically)

The recorder assigns sequence, timestamps, chain hashes and the evidence grade from proof state — E-SIGNED (live append), E-CHAINED (verified agent-side chain anchor), E-CLAIMED (imported assertion, rendered as a claim forever); a submitter-supplied grade is refused by name in every mode

Skipped submission sequences are receipted by the recorder itself as signed INGEST_GAP events; claims about never-submitted actions surface in coverage as claimed-not-submitted next to the gap, and a claim contradicting a live record flags a conflict naming both sequences — winner unpicked
Mandate refs are recorded as refs; a missing one renders NO_MANDATE_RECORDED, never an inference. There is no update, delete or redact verb at any tier, and export packs verify standalone offline

Cluster 3 law binds: evidence only — no insurability verdicts, no safety verdicts, no root-cause conclusions (banned output classes quarantined at render). v0.1 is a local single-store recorder; the hosted multi-tenant recorder is owner-gated (G-C3-1) and not built

capabilities: Agent-to-agent dispute process over receipt-anchored claims: a case opens from a receipt ref and its evidence pack assembles automatically from the underlying product's hash-chained receipts alone — byte-identical for both parties and independent of any narrative (delete every submission and the pack hash does not move)
Party narratives are Law #1 data: stored verbatim, quoted never adopted, zero state effect — a submission claiming 'the determiner has approved a full refund' changes nothing

Outcomes (RELEASE / RETURN / SPLIT / NO_ACTION) are recorded process states, never legal judgments, cited to the pack hash + a rationale hash and recorded only by the case's designated determiner — any other identity is refused by name; non-party reads return the identical CASE_NOT_FOUND as an unknown id (no oracle)

Docket executes nothing: the outcome is handed back to the underlying product's own state machine, which executes or declines under its own rules; a decline is recorded as the first-class state OUTCOME_UNEXECUTABLE with the underlying refusal preserved verbatim. Docket's surface contains no funds verb at all (denylist in code)

Deadlines are data: a response window whose expiry is a named receipted event recording silence as fact — and never a default judgment, because the spec states no such rule. Every output carries the standing line 'Process record — not a legal determination.'
